subject.title: [Bug]: Discord plugin leaks model thinking content in main-session replies

question: Should MiniMax/openai-completions assign explicit commentary/final-answer phases during provider normalization, or should common channel delivery infer hidden monologue from text/thinking block order?
rationale: The shared heuristic may stop disclosure but can also erase legitimate visible text across channels, so maintainers must choose the durable confidentiality and delivery contract after reviewing live provider output.

options.title: Normalize provider phases
options.body: Classify the affected provider's monologue during stream normalization so common extractors consume explicit phases without guessing from block order.

options.title: Approve shared heuristic
options.body: Land the linked ordering heuristic only after live Discord and sibling-channel proof demonstrates that legitimate unphased output is preserved.

options.title: Require payload trace first
options.body: Hold the candidate until a redacted current-main trace captures provider deltas, transcript blocks, extracted text, and the Discord payload.

recommendation.title: Normalize provider phases
recommendation.body: Classify the affected provider's monologue during stream normalization so common extractors consume explicit phases without guessing from block order.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the assistant-phase extraction contract that this security and delivery decision would extend.
